description: Commit 1d77c05 pads a fused Linear bias before slicing it by the fused tensor's frange, reversing the weight path's slice-then-pad order and potentially leaving bias incompatible with the padded weight.
trigger: Load an fkey/frange Linear for which a tensor exists at key + '.bias'.
expected_behavior: Weight and bias select the same logical output range and are then padded to the same output width.
actual_behavior: Weight is sliced then padded, while bias is padded as a per-layer tensor and then sliced using fused-tensor bounds; the result can lose padding or fall outside the bias.

introductions.scope: The task diff introduces pad_out and the bias pad-before-slice ordering in the fused branch.

observations.source: Independent Fable mailbox review of the task diff and fused load_fp16 branch.
observations.reach: Conditional on a per-layer bias existing for a fused layer; no qualifying model layout was established.
observations.limits: Source verified ordering only; tensor operations and model loading were not executed.
